decisions.reason: The existing message-750 MODIFY already removes the obsolete multi-board alignment and connector-placement attributes and records that interboard alignment is no longer required.
The existing message-750 MODIFY already disables interboard connectors, removes the obsolete interboard interface details, and limits the state to the integrated-board architecture.
The existing message-750 MODIFY fully records the transition to one integrated board and removes the obsolete separate-board list.
The existing message-750 MODIFY already moves the unchanged antenna-placement requirement into the integrated-board context.

The single-board decision eliminates the separate power-board architecture, but the source does not resolve whether enclosure fit, USB-C edge placement, mounting holes, and compactness constraints transfer to the integrated board or become obsolete.
The existing message-750 MODIFY already records the integrated architecture, connector reduction, JLCPCB Basic preference, and cost-optimization goal.
The source establishes an integrated board but does not state whether the former power board's four-layer requirement carries over or whether a new layer stack must be selected.
The separate main board is replaced by an integrated board, but the source does not determine whether its four-layer stack remains applicable to the new board.
The source does not establish whether the former main-board 70×50 mm dimensions or prototype sizing flexibility should transfer to the integrated board or be discarded.
The candidate has no client-confirmed layer-count attribute to update or remove, and the source does not specify the integrated board's layer stack.

The existing message-750 MODIFY already migrates the external sensor fanout to the integrated board, disables interboard connectors, and removes the obsolete interboard inputs and total connector count.
The existing message-750 MODIFY already relocates panel power control to the integrated board and replaces the interboard PWRON tap with a direct integrated-board connection.
